sentence: Under Section 15 of the Punjab Rented Premises Act, rent must be paid within thirty days [1].

evidence.content:
7. Payment of rent.– (1) A tenant shall pay or tender the rent to the landlord in the 
mode and by the date mentioned in the tenancy agreement. 
(2) If the date of payment is not mentioned in the tenancy agreement, a 
tenant shall pay or tender the rent not later than tenth day of the following month. 
(3) If the mode of payment is not mentioned i n the tenancy agreement, a 
tenant shall pay or tender the rent to the landlord through money order or deposit in 
the bank account of the landlord.

Whoever commits qatl-e-amd shall, subject to the provisions of this Chapter be: 
(a) punished with death as qisas; 
(b) punished with death or imprisonment for life as ta'zir having regard to the facts and 
circumstances of the case, if the proof in either of the forms specified in Section 304 is not
